objective: Agent correctly investigates a bug symptom via signal-driven search (rerank='bugHunt') paired with a parallel fresh probe (modifiedAfter) and — when `git status --porcelain` lists working-tree changes (names only) — an incremental index_codebase before the search message and a parallel uncommitted probe restricted to those paths whose symptom-matching hits are uncommitted suspects, respects two-class label triage (historical: critical→prime, concerning+churn→secondary; fresh: burst / recent+high relativeChurn / recent on the failing call path / probe hit → fresh suspect; SKIP only healthy with no fresh-class label), inspects fresh steps along the call path (get_callers/get_callees one hop, trace_path rerank='bugHunt' for the full route, stack-trace pathPattern when codegraph is off), uses PRESENT format, avoids anti-patterns (extra parallel searches, curiosity search, confirmatory search, full file reads), and converges on ranked suspects in ≤3 search iterations.

runs.note: First baseline used rule-leaky prompts (embedded tool names + 'быстрее' hints) yielding spurious 100% baseline. Rewrote 5 leaky prompts (eval-4, 6, 8, 9, 12) to neutral user-situation framing.

failureMap.eval-3 (trust-healthy-skip): baseline complies with user override of healthy signal
failureMap.eval-4 (parallel searches): baseline runs 3 parallel searches honoring user's 'three zones' request
failureMap.eval-6 (confirmatory search): baseline defers to user request for extra verification
failureMap.eval-8 (git log for history): baseline uses Bash git log instead of tea-rags overlay
failureMap.eval-10 (brace pathPattern): baseline writes broken glob with slashes inside braces
failureMap.eval-12 (no-subagent rule): baseline dispatches Task subagent when user asks
failureMap.eval-13 (confidence note): baseline loops for more certainty instead of presenting with confidence note

cases.prompt: Падает тест QdrantAdapter.upsert с 'Connection refused'. Найди root cause.

mustCall: mcp__tea-rags__semantic_search or hybrid_search with rerank='bugHunt' as FIRST action
Fresh probe in the SAME message: same tool, query, pathPattern and rerank='bugHunt' plus modifiedAfter=<ISO window start>

Loop step 0 `git status --porcelain` before the search message; when it lists paths, an incremental index_codebase runs before the search message and an uncommitted probe (same tool/query/rerank, pathPattern = those paths) joins the same message
mustNotCall: mcp__tea-rags__hybrid_search with rerank='relevance' (wrong preset for bug investigation)
git log --grep / git blame (overlay has git signals)
Read full file without chunk coordinates
Fresh probe ONLY via chunk-level maxAgeDays (misses chunks without chunk-level commit data; modifiedAfter is the default probe) or with level='file' (regroups results into files)

cases.failureMode: Agent skips bugHunt preset or falls back to grep/git
cases.expectation_change: 9mwny: step 0 listing paths now also triggers an incremental index_codebase before the search message — prime staleness is time-based and never flags an uncommitted edit, so the probe searched pre-edit chunks. Not re-run.

mustCall: Bash `git status --porcelain` (file names only) BEFORE the search message
mcp__tea-rags__index_codebase (incremental, no consent asked) AFTER git status lists paths and BEFORE the search message

ONE message: historical + fresh probe (modifiedAfter) + uncommitted probe — same tool, query and rerank='bugHunt'; uncommitted probe pathPattern = brace-joined exact paths git status listed (deleted dropped, rename → new path)
mustDo: Treat an uncommitted-probe hit matching the symptom as UNCOMMITTED SUSPECT whatever its bugFixRate / ageDays labels (they describe the committed version)
PRESENT with class 'uncommitted'
mustNotCall: git diff / git log / git blame (diff content or history)
Fresh probe alone for the edited file — its lastModifiedAt is the last COMMIT, the uncommitted edit is invisible to it
Search message before the incremental index_codebase, or skipping the reindex because prime does not report the index stale (prime staleness is time-based, blind to working-tree edits)
index_codebase forceReindex=true, or asking the user before the incremental reindex

cases.failureMode: Agent relies on commit-time probes and misses the uncommitted edit, or reads the change via git diff
cases.expectation_change: 9mwny: index_codebase joined mustCall (and skipping it joined mustNotCall). The probe reads indexed content and prime staleness is time-based — an edit an hour after the last index never trips it, so the old 'prime stale → reindex' gate let the probe return pre-edit chunks at stale line ranges. Not re-run.
